newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Polledo rallies in weak bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Polledo rallies in weak bolsa.

text.p: Shares of Argentine construction company Polledo surged Friday defying a slump on the Buenos Aires bolsa, dealers said.
Traders said Polledo was climbing on fresh talk that the government planned to tender the concessions for the hydro-electric dam Yacyreta by decree instead of waiting for congressional approval.
"If the dam is finally privatized, Polledo will be able to collect its debts with the government (for the construction of Yacyreta) and see its profits rise," one trader said.
Polledo stock rose 2.7 percent to $1.15 against a drop of 1.2 percent on the weighted MerVal index to 715.63.
It was the only stock that closed flat Thursday when the MerVal fell 2.4 percent on Wall Street's two-day shakeout.
Yacyreta, which is jointly owned by Paraguay and Argentina, is one of the world's largest hydro-electric projects.
